Soft Autumn vs True Autumn

Soft Autumn and True Autumn are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same depth. The difference is undertone: Soft Autumn is warm-neutral, True Autumn is warm; contrast: Soft Autumn is low, True Autumn is medium; chroma: Soft Autumn is soft, True Autumn is soft-medium.

Questions

What is the difference between Soft Autumn and True Autumn?

Soft Autumn and True Autumn are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same depth. The difference is undertone: Soft Autumn is warm-neutral, True Autumn is warm; contrast: Soft Autumn is low, True Autumn is medium; chroma: Soft Autumn is soft, True Autumn is soft-medium.

Can I be between Soft Autumn and True Autumn?

Yes. Neighbouring seasons share a lot, and many people sit near the border. That's why Season Card shows your closest season and a runner-up.

How do I tell if I'm Soft Autumn or True Autumn?

Focus on undertone and contrast and chroma. In daylight, compare a colour from each palette under your chin, for example muted salmon (Soft Autumn) and salmon (True Autumn), and see which makes your skin look more even.
